title: Hello, Svelte
excerpt: Kicking off this demo blog built with SvelteKit and a JSON database.
body:
Welcome to the Exabyte demo blog.

This site is built with SvelteKit and stores every post in a single JSON file. No database server, no CMS — just a file the app reads at build time.

It is intentionally small so an AI agent can extend it during a live workshop.

title: Why a JSON "database"?
excerpt: A single JSON file is enough for a demo blog — and easy for an agent to edit.
body:
For a workshop demo we do not need Postgres.

A JSON file gives us version control, trivial diffs in a pull request, and zero infrastructure. When the AI agent adds a feature it can read and modify plain data the same way a developer would.

Trade-offs: no concurrent writes and everything loads into memory. Fine for a blog with a handful of posts.

title: The AI agent workflow
excerpt: ClickUp task in, reviewed pull request out — an agent does the middle.
body:
The demo shows a full loop.

A developer files a task in ClickUp. A LangGraph agent fetches it, writes a test, implements the change, opens a pull request, and comments the PR link back on the ticket.

The human stays in control: they review the diff and merge. Netlify deploys the result.

title: Demo Blog Post
excerpt: A new demo blog post created by the AI agent to showcase automated content generation.
body:
This is a demo blog post created by an AI agent as part of a live workshop.

The agent read the task from ClickUp, added this entry to the JSON data file, wrote corresponding tests, and opened a pull request — all without human intervention.

This demonstrates how AI agents can automate routine content creation tasks while keeping a human in the loop for review and approval.

title: Why Developers Should Learn About AI
excerpt: Understanding AI fundamentals is becoming essential for modern software development.
body:
Artificial intelligence is reshaping the software landscape.

From code generation to intelligent debugging, AI tools are becoming part of every developer's toolkit. Learning how these models work, their strengths and limitations, allows developers to build better, safer, and more innovative applications.

This post explains why every developer should invest time in understanding AI beyond the hype.

title: The Importance of Implementing an AI Agent for Developers
excerpt: Why every developer team should consider implementing an AI agent to automate repetitive tasks and accelerate development.
body:
The modern development environment is filled with repetitive tasks: writing boilerplate, running tests, updating documentation, and managing deployments. An AI agent can take over many of these chores, freeing developers to focus on creative problem-solving.

Implementing an agent doesn't just boost productivity; it also reduces human error and ensures consistency across the codebase. By integrating with tools like ClickUp and GitHub, an agent can autonomously pick up tickets, write code, open pull requests, and even update project status.

This blog post explores practical steps to implement such an agent, the pitfalls to avoid, and the long-term benefits of a human-agent collaboration model.

body:
